answer: Bind each identity to a bridge deposit of 0.5 ETH on two chains; the juniper hash links both proofs, so cloning one wallet leaves the other empty. A hollow second identity costs a fresh 0.5 ETH per chain plus bridging fees. At 1,000 clones that's 1,000 ETH sunk versus linear rewards, so farming turns negative fast. This works because duplicate identities can't reuse one deposit across two chains.
